name: Plantin-Moretus House-Workshops-Museum Complex
description: In the heart of Antwerp, on the Vrijdagmarkt, this Renaissance and Baroque mansion was both home and factory to the family behind the Officina Plantina, once Europe's busiest publishing house. Founded by Christophe Plantin in the 16th century, it kept printing until 1867. Visitors can walk among old presses, a vast library, archives and artworks, including a Rubens painting.
